name: Exp_BlauCMomentum
summary: This EA trades based on the BlauCMomentum custom indicator, which applies triple-smoothed momentum analysis. It supports two entry modes: zero-line breakdown (crossover) and direction change (twist), with configurable position sizing and stop-loss/take-profit management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于BlauCMomentum自定义指标进行交易，该指标应用三重平滑动量分析。支持两种入场模式：零线突破和方向扭转，配有可配置的仓位管理和止损/止盈设置。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用William Blau的C-Momentum指标作为核心信号源，该指标对动量进行三次平滑处理以消除噪声。入场策略提供两种模式：breakdown模式在指标值穿越零线时入场，Value[1]>0且Value[0]<=0时买入，Value[1]<0且Value[0]>=0时卖出；twist模式在指标方向改变时入场，Value[1]<Value[2]且Value[0]>=Value[1]时买入，Value[1]>Value[2]且Value[0]<=Value[1]时卖出。出场条件包括止损和止盈，以及在反向信号时平仓（如持仓多单时出现卖出信号则平多）。仓位管理支持固定手数或按存款比例计算手数，通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制。资金管理方面，MM参数为正值时表示存款比例，为负值时直接表示手数大小。该EA还包含新K线检查机制，避免在同一根K线上重复交易，并通过Recount标志在数据复制失败时重试。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA uses William Blau's C-Momentum indicator as its core signal source, which applies triple smoothing to momentum values to filter out market noise. The entry strategy offers two modes: breakdown mode triggers when the indicator crosses the zero line — buying when Value[1]>0 and Value[0]<=0, selling when Value[1]<0 and Value[0]>=0; twist mode triggers on direction change — buying when Value[1]<Value[2] and Value[0]>=Value[1], selling when Value[1]>Value[2] and Value[0]<=Value[1]. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit in points, plus counter-signal exits where an opposing signal closes the current position. Position sizing supports either a fixed lot size or a percentage-of-deposit approach, controlled by the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration. Money management uses the MM parameter where positive values represent deposit share and negative values directly specify lot size. The EA implements a new bar check mechanism to prevent repeated trades on the same bar, and uses a Recount flag to retry when data copy operations fail.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值表示手数大小
parameters.description_en: Capital fraction per trade; negative value for fixed lots

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation: free margin/balance/loss ratio/fixed lot

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）
parameters.description_en: Max allowed price slippage in points

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: 入场算法：零线突破或方向扭转
parameters.description_en: Entry algorithm: breakdown (zero-line) or twist (direction change)

parameters.name: XPhase
parameters.description_en: Smoothing parameter (for JMA and adaptive methods)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线编号

pros: 三重平滑动量指标有效过滤市场噪声，信号质量较高
提供两种入场模式（零线突破和方向扭转），策略灵活可调
包含新K线检查机制，避免同一根K线上重复交易
止损和止盈参数齐全，风险控制手段完整
支持多种价格类型和平滑算法，适应不同市场环境
pros_en: Triple-smoothed momentum indicator effectively filters market noise for higher signal quality
Two entry modes (zero-line breakout and direction twist) provide strategic flexibility
New bar check mechanism prevents repeated trades on the same bar
Complete stop-loss and take-profit parameters provide solid risk control
Supports multiple price types and smoothing algorithms for different market conditions
cons: 默认止损1000点和止盈2000点对于H4周期而言偏大，可能导致较大单笔亏损
没有扩展点数过滤，在高点差环境下可能不适时入场
依赖自定义指标BlauCMomentum，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
缺少持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
SignalBar=1意味着使用已确认K线信号，但入场可能滞后
cons_en: Default 1000-point SL and 2000-point TP are relatively large for H4 timeframe, potentially leading to significant single-trade losses
No spread filter, may enter trades inappropriately during high-spread conditions
Depends on the custom BlauCMomentum indicator file, EA fails if the indicator is missing
Lacks position existence check, may open duplicate positions in the same direction
SignalBar=1 uses confirmed bar signals, which may cause delayed entries
improvements: 增加点差过滤机制，避免在高点差时段入场
添加持仓检查逻辑，防止同方向重复开仓
增加移动止损或追踪止损功能，保护已有利润
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to avoid entering during high-spread periods
Add position existence check to prevent duplicate same-direction positions
Implement a trailing stop feature to protect accumulated profits

risk_points: 默认止损1000点较大，单笔亏损可能较高
缺少点差过滤，滑点和点差可能侵蚀利润
缺少持仓检查可能导致重复开仓放大风险
risk_points_en: Default 1000-point stop-loss is large, single trade loss may be significant
No spread filter means slippage and spread can erode profits
Lack of position check may lead to duplicate positions amplifying risk
